name: momo-workspace
description: npm workspaces root (ADR-0137 D3). Holds packages/* only — no task runner, by decision: Nx/Turborepo are oversized for one shared package.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @momo/core && npm --prefix clients/web run test
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @momo/core && npm --prefix clients/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @momo/core && npm --prefix clients/web run typecheck
